shell.title: E-signature
shell.subtitle: Build an envelope from a template or a PDF, set who signs and in what order, sign from the signer view with a code and a handwritten mark, and review the evidence with its hash chain.
shell.legalLine: Colombian reference: Law 527 of 1999 and Decree 2364 of 2012 (compiled in Decree 1074 of 2015). This demo does not sign documents with legal validity: it shows how the platform we build for your company would work.
shell.resetConfirm: Clear your changes and go back to the sample data?
shell.resetDone: The demo is back to the sample data.

how.title: What is real and what is simulated in this demo
real: What you do is saved in your browser and survives a reload; “Reset demo” goes back to the sample data.
The indicators are computed from the envelope list: they change when you send, sign or void, or when an envelope expires.
The SHA-256 fingerprint of the PDF you upload or of the template text is computed in your browser; the file never leaves your device.
Every step adds an event to the evidence, chained with SHA-256 hashes; “Verify integrity” recomputes the chain.
The CSV files, the envelope JSON and the sample PDFs (evidence certificate and signed document) are really generated and downloaded.
The signature is drawn with the mouse or a finger, typed or uploaded as an image, and it goes into the PDF.
sim: No email, SMS or WhatsApp message is sent: the verification code is shown on screen.
Identity verification with ID and selfie, digital signature with a certificate and the timestamp from a digital certification authority (ECD) are simulated.
The IP addresses in the evidence are samples (ranges reserved for documentation).
The company, people, emails (.example) and documents are fictitious; the template texts were not reviewed by a lawyer.
Integrations and the API are built in your project; here they are only described.
tour: In “Home”, look at the indicators and the envelope list, and open the evidence of the completed employment contract.
Click “New envelope”, choose the “Fixed-term employment contract” template and change the worker’s name.
Check the signers and the order, place the fields by tapping the page and send the envelope.
In “Signer view”, open the document, request the code, type it, sign with your finger or mouse and accept.
In “Evidence”, verify the hash chain and download the PDF certificate.

types.title: Which type of signature?
types.subtitle: Concepts from Colombian regulation and what this demo does with each one.

electronic.name: Electronic signature
electronic.what: Identifies the signer (for example, with a one-time code) and keeps the evidence of the process.
electronic.demo: In this demo: this is the one simulated end to end.

digital.name: Digital signature
digital.what: Uses a digital certificate issued by a digital certification authority (ECD) accredited by ONAC.
digital.demo: In this demo: you can choose it, but the certificate is simulated. In your project it is integrated with the ECD you choose.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.what: Time seal issued by an ECD (RFC 3161 protocol) proving the document existed at that moment.
timestamp.demo: In this demo: simulated when the envelope is completed.

types.note: These descriptions are for guidance and do not replace legal advice. The demo does not produce legally binding signatures.

employment.name: Fixed-term employment contract
employment.desc: Individual contract with position, salary, duration and probation period.
employment.body:
FIXED-TERM INDIVIDUAL EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

Between CORDILLERA SERVICIOS TEMPORALES S.A.S., NIT 901.537.284-9, hereinafter THE EMPLOYER, and {name}, holder of citizenship ID {idNumber}, hereinafter THE EMPLOYEE, this contract is entered into:

FIRST. Purpose. THE EMPLOYEE will personally provide services as {position} in the city of {city}.

SECOND. Duration. The contract lasts {months} months starting on {startDate}.

THIRD. Salary. THE EMPLOYER will pay a monthly salary of {salary}, paid every two weeks in arrears.

FOURTH. Working hours. Working hours will be the legal maximum in force, distributed according to the internal work rules.

FIFTH. Probation period. The parties agree on a probation period equal to one fifth of the initial term.

In witness whereof, the parties sign by electronic means.

Sample text for this demo; not a template reviewed by a lawyer.
